concepts.definition: Average total remuneration in Australian dollars paid to employees of the employer reporting unit over the WGEA reporting year, for a stated workforce segment (total workforce or a pay quartile). This is a pay level, not revenue, business income or an exact headcount.
concepts.why_not_existing: No shortlisted concept covers remuneration or pay levels; ext.financial.total_income, ext.financial.taxable_income and ext.financial.revenue_band are business income/revenue measures owned by business, not employer pay measures owned by the employer reporting unit, and reusing them would change meaning and owner.
